answer: Like subterranean mycelium fusing into onyx stone under ancient pressure, decentralized consensus roots identity in web-of-trust staking. At network dawn, agents crystallize peer endorsements into an interlocking mesh where validating new peers requires quadratic collateral. Forging counterfeit identities is no harmless fable: attacker costs scale with superlinear polynomial cost O(n²), starving Sybil swarms of viable yield.
